slides.say: Conditional rendering in React needs no special syntax. Plain JavaScript if works.
If the item is packed, return early with a check mark. Otherwise, fall through to the plain item.

slides.text: Branching logic lives in JavaScript. JSX just describes each result.
slides.say: Your branching logic is just JavaScript: if statements and early returns. JSX only describes what each branch shows.

slides.text: Big differences between branches? Early return with if is easy to read.
slides.say: Takeaway: when branches return quite different trees, an early return with if keeps things clear.
